title: TalkBack MCP get_session_decisions tool result (v1)
description: Structured output of tools/call for tool name get_session_decisions. v1 maps 1:1 to persisted Postgres session and decision_stances rows; no LLM-inferred fields. See docs/mcp-session-decisions-schema.md.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bump when adding required fields or breaking semantics.

premise.description: sessions.premise when set; omitted when NULL in DB.

primary_decision.description: sessions.primary_decision when set; omitted when NULL in DB.

decision_outcome.description: sessions.decision_outcome when set; omitted when NULL in DB.

decision_stances.description: All rows from decision_stances for this session, joined with submitter email (newest-first in DB; JSON array order is implementation-defined—do not rely on sort).

user_id.description: users.id of the participant who submitted the stance

rationale.description: Optional free text; omitted when NULL.

user_email.description: Submitter email from users join (same exposure as HTTP GET /api/sessions/{id}/stances).
